description: This Swift source file defines a lightweight, heterogeneous JSON payload wrapper called `AnyCodable`, which conforms to `Codable`, `Hashable`, and `Sendable`. It provides mechanisms to encode and decode various foundational types dynamically, enabling flexible serialization and deserialization of arbitrary JSON-like data structures.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A versatile wrapper for encoding and decoding JSON payloads of heterogeneous types, supporting comparison and hashing.
